product_one_liner.value: Levitate is a relationship-marketing platform that helps relationship-based businesses build and maintain client and prospect relationships through personalized outreach and marketing tools.
product_one_liner.notes: Levitate describes its platform as equipping relationship-based businesses to engage clients, donors, referral sources, and prospects, with personalized outreach tools. Source: https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/levitate-raises-16m-to-bring-ai-to-relationship-based-businesses-302704595.html

pricing_page.notes: The public plans page presents Levitate Essential and Levitate Preferred, so a public pricing/plans page exists even if pricing requires contacting sales. Source: https://www.levitate.ai/pricing

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The customer success stories page includes named testimonials from CVW Financial and True Cool Air. Source: https://www.levitate.ai/success-stories | named_customers.0: CVW Financial appears in a customer testimonial on Levitate’s success stories page. Source: https://www.levitate.ai/success-stories | named_customers.1: True Cool Air appears in a customer testimonial on Levitate’s success stories page. Source: https://www.levitate.ai/success-stories

employee_band.notes: Levitate’s LinkedIn company profile lists company size as 201–500 employees. Source: https://linkedin.com/company/11737049

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The headquarters listing identifies Raleigh as the city. Source: https://theorg.com/org/levitate-ai | hq_country: The headquarters listing identifies Raleigh, United States. Source: https://theorg.com/org/levitate-ai

founded_year.notes: Levitate’s official story states it was founded in 2017. Source: https://www.levitate.ai/story

eng_blog.notes: The blog index and author list show marketing-focused content and marketing-role authors, not at least two engineer-authored posts about how the product is built. Source: https://www.levitate.ai/blog

public_docs.notes: The public Help Center has categories with numerous product articles, including automation guides and user-management/setup instructions. Sources: https://help.levitate.ai/category/216-automations and https://help.levitate.ai/category/214-user-settings-setup

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The open job board lists five roles—Revenue Insights Coordinator, three Sales Development Representative positions, and Manager, Account Executive—and none has an AI, ML, or data-science title. Source: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/levitate?gh_src=levitate

model_provider.notes: Levitate’s page listing its underlying AI model providers names Anthropic, Google, and OpenAI. Source: https://www.levitate.ai/underlying-ai-model-providers

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The company Trust Center names SOC 2, HIPAA, and PCI DSS - SAQ A; those are the certifications listed. Source: https://trust.levitate.ai/ | compliance_certs.2: The Trust Center names PCI DSS - SAQ A. Source: https://trust.levitate.ai/

raised_18mo.notes: The latest round is a Series D dated 2026-03-05, and the dated announcement is within the 18 months before 2026-11-09. Sources: https://tracxn.com/a/d/company/5ae4c9b5e4b0fb0e4735ae5b/levitate#a:about and https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/levitate-raises-16m-to-bring-ai-to-relationship-based-businesses-302704595.html

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The Levitate job posting is titled Sales Development Representative, identifies Toronto, and says the position is being publicly advertised to support ongoing hiring needs. Source: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/levitate/jobs/5209244008?gh_src=levitate

launched_6mo.notes: The company announced that it had rolled out new AI features in a September 25, 2026 post, within six months of the 2026-11-09 reference date. Sources: https://www.levitate.ai/blog-posts/new-in-levitate-ai-tools-built-around-the-work-you-already-do and https://www.levitate.ai/blog/new-in-levitate-ai-tools-built-around-the-work-you-already-do

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The leadership page lists C-level and VP-level team members, but does not provide comprehensive joining or departure dates. The dated Casey Brady profile evidence describes a promotion, not a confirmed join or departure. The available sources therefore do not establish whether someone joined or left in the specified window. Sources: https://www.levitate.ai/story and https://linkedin.com/in/casey-brady
